statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-33056 (GHSA-j4xf-2g29-59ph, RUSTSEC-2026-0067): in the Rust tar crate 0.4.44 and earlier, unpack_dir uses fs::metadata(), which follows symbolic links, to check whether an existing path is a directory, so a crafted archive with a symlink followed by a directory entry of the same name can change the permissions of a directory outside the extraction root. It is fixed in tar 0.4.45 by commit 17b1fd8, which uses fs::symlink_metadata() instead: https://github.com/alexcrichton/tar-rs/security/advisories/GHSA-j4xf-2g29-59ph, https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2026-0067.html, https://github.com/alexcrichton/tar-rs/commit/17b1fd84e632071cb8eef9d3709bf347bd266446. Alpine backports that commit to the tar 0.4.44 bundled with cargo from its rust 1.91.1-r1 recipe on: https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/commit/be4aca58ed826edf507ea06314a6b46cb0348e80. Scanned every package of this owner published in the DHI Alpine 3.23 repository, for x86_64 and aarch64: all 17 packages (rust, cargo, rustc-dev, rustfmt, rust-clippy, rust-dbg, rust-src, rust-wasm, rust-uefi, rust-gdb, rust-lldb and the doc and completion packages) of builds 1.91.1-r0, 1.91.1-r3 and 1.91.1-r4, and build 1.91.1-r2, which publishes only rust and cargo. Every file, including the .rlib archives and the .rmeta compiler metadata, was searched for the crate's source paths, which name the crate version it was built from. Apart from its debug symbols in rust-dbg, the cargo program (/usr/bin/cargo) is the only file in these packages that contains the tar crate's source paths; it is compiled with tar 0.4.44 in every build. In each build's cargo, on x86_64 and aarch64, we located the code of unpack_dir by its error message format (' when creating dir ') and read which C library call it makes to inspect the existing path: in 1.91.1-r0 it calls stat, which follows symbolic links (unfixed); in 1.91.1-r2, -r3 and -r4 it calls lstat, which does not (fixed). For -r0, -r3 and -r4 on both architectures the published debug symbols (rust-dbg) confirm that this code is tar's EntryFields::unpack_dir; -r2 publishes no debug symbols. 1.91.1-r2 is the first fixed build, and every later build carries the fix.
